answer_1.quote: We investigate language confusion on the line and word level in two practical settings: a) Monolingual generation, where a user queries the LLM in a given language, implicitly requesting an answer in the same language; and b) cross-lingual generation, where a user explicitly instructs a model to generate text in a different language.
